msg: {"type": "say", "text": "That was a lot of information."}
{"type": "say", "text": "It sounds like you've made a huge jump in your career with that Vice President role."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Got it."}
{"type": "say", "text": "So the COO is the one who actually feels the pain of delivery, making them the perfect target to get a yes."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Once they're on board, the director just handles the check."}
{"type": "say", "text": "So it's a bit of a power shift."}
{"type": "say", "text": "He's the one steering the ship for now, but you're the one providing the map to get where he needs to go."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Sounds like you've got the internal politics mapped out."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Since you know the rhythm of how they operate, you're in a great spot to play it smart."}
{"type": "say", "text": "It's a steady rhythm, but I prefer the chaos of a new challenge over a routine."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm more of a \"solve the puzzle\" type than a \"follow the manual\" type."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Since you're dealing with conventional processes, keep an eye on the bottlenecks."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Usually, the gap between the decision-maker's \"yes\" and the actual execution is where things stall."}
{"type": "say", "text": "That's a rare and valuable thing."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Having a circle of peers you actually trust makes the corporate game a lot less exhausting."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I was just saying you're the one providing the map, but it sounds like you're playing it safe by keeping your distance for now."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Smart move to wait for the right opening before making a direct move."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Keeping it to the weekends makes it much easier to manage."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Sounds like a perfect break, and coffee plantations usually make for a great view."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Go for it, let me know what you find."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Sounds like a fresh start in a new spot."}
{"type": "say", "text": "No worries at all."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Hey there."}
{"type": "say", "text": "What's on your mind?"}
{"type": "say", "text": "LA is a big change from a hill station."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm well aware, since I'm the one talking."}
